description.value:
You unleash a burst of telekinetic force in a 60-foot radius centered on a point you choose within range. Each creature in the area must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 12d6 force damage, being knocked prone, and being pushed 5 feet in a direction of your choice on a failure, or taking half as much damage and suffering neither effect on a success.

When cast using a 9th-level force slot, the damage increases by 2d6.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Light Side Powers, Level 8
